ad2_first_apartment_furnish.text: Your first apartment contains you and a floor. Furniture is now a personal philosophy.

ad2_roommate_ad.text: You need a roommate to cover half the rent. Three people answer your ad. One brings a ferret to the interview.

outcomes.great: The ferret is a delight. The rent arrives on time. You have never been luckier.
outcomes.chaos: The ferret eats a charger, a sock and your security deposit.

ad2_phone_swim.text: Your phone slips out of your pocket and into a puddle. Every photo you own is in there, and the screen now glows a gentle green.

outcomes.saved: The technician revives it and charges you for the miracle.
outcomes.gone: The phone is gone. So are all your photos. You feel strangely light.

ad2_group_chat_misfire.text: You send a detailed complaint about your boss to a group chat. Your boss is in the group chat.

outcomes.laughs: Your boss replies with a laughing face. You never fully relax again.
outcomes.note: A formal meeting appears on your calendar. A small bonus quietly vanishes.

ad2_hostel_trip.text: You book a month of backpacking abroad. Your bag weighs more than your plan.

outcomes.magic: You meet strangers who feel like old friends and eat something you cannot name. Perfect.
outcomes.robbed: Your bag is stolen on day four. You learn to travel light, involuntarily.

ad2_side_hustle.text: Everyone has a side hustle now. You have a free weekend and a rumor that people pay for things.

ad2_hustle_boom.text: Your little side hustle gets an order so large you suspect an error. The payment clears. It was not an error.

outcomes.boom: You hire a friend, rent a corner, and discover that spreadsheets are a love language.
outcomes.bust: You overbuy stock and underbuy sleep. The wave passes and leaves you boxes.

ad2_landlord_deposit.text: Your landlord keeps your whole deposit for "unusual wear." The wear was you, living there.

outcomes.win: The judge reads your photos like poetry. You get your money back.
outcomes.lose: The judge sighs at both of you. Nobody leaves happy.

ad2_car_dies.text: Your car dies on a quiet road with a noise like a sad cow. Your phone has 4 percent battery.

outcomes.handy: A video, a wrench and pure hope. It starts. You tell this story for years.
outcomes.worse: You find a new noise. The new noise costs more.

ad2_jury_duty.text: A summons arrives: jury duty, Monday, no exceptions except for the exceptions.

outcomes.dismissed: Dismissed in nine minutes. You are home for lunch, slightly proud.
outcomes.foreman: The lawyers adore you. You become foreman. The trial lasts three weeks.

ad2_identity_theft.text: A bank alert shows a purchase of a boat motor in a state you have never visited. You do not own a boat.

ad2_idtheft_resolve.text: A letter arrives about the stolen identity case. It is written in the calm voice of someone who has never been robbed.

outcomes.cleared: Every charge is reversed and your record is clean. You celebrate with a small cake.
outcomes.stuck: Three departments pass you around like a hot potato. The charges stay until spring.

ad2_neighbor_noise.text: Your upstairs neighbor practices the drums every night at 11. He is not good yet, but he is committed.

ad2_friend_couch.text: {{name}} needs a couch for two nights. It is now day nine, and the couch has a permanent dent.

ad2_friend_date_rescue.text: {{name}} texts you the code word "pineapple." It means the date is going badly and you must invent an emergency.

outcomes.saved: You call with a fake flood. {{name}} escapes and owes you pancakes for life.
outcomes.good: The date was actually going well. You ruined it. {{name}} sulks for a week.

ad2_band_start.text: A friend of a friend needs a bass player. You do not play bass. You say yes anyway.

ad2_noodle_month.text: The month is longer than the money. Your pantry contains three noodle packets and a single lime.

ad2_night_class.text: You sign up for a pottery class to seem more interesting. Beside you, somebody ruins a bowl and laughs about it kindly.

outcomes.spark: You laugh about the bowl for an hour. The wheel keeps spinning, and so does your heart.
outcomes.friends: You become pottery friends and never find the courage to ask for more.

ad2_sibling_dent.text: {{name}} borrows your car "for ten minutes" and returns it nine hours later with a new dent and a story.

ad2_mother_care_package.text: {{name}} mails you a care package: three jars, a sweater, and a note that says "eat something green."

ad2_job_other_city.text: A job offer arrives from a city you have never seen. The pay is better and the weather is a mystery.

outcomes.thrive: You find a better coffee shop, a shorter commute and a new self.
outcomes.lonely: The pay is good. The evenings are very quiet. You buy a plant for company.

ad2_social_club.text: Making friends as an adult requires structure. A local hiking club meets Saturdays and promises "light chat."

ad2_partner_dog.text: {{name}} shows you a picture of a rescue dog. You said "maybe." {{name}} heard "yes."

ad2_garden_start.text: A bare patch of yard stares at you every morning. A neighbor says tomatoes are "basically free." Nobody mentions the work.

ad2_garden_prize.text: Your garden has produced a zucchini the size of a baseball bat. The local fair has a category for this.

outcomes.ribbon: First place. You receive a ribbon, a handshake and an envy that fills the room.
outcomes.second: Second place, behind a pumpkin whose owner does not make eye contact.

ad2_midlife_purchase.text: You wake up one day wanting a motorcycle. Everyone around you looks unsurprised.

outcomes.thrill: The wind, the noise, the helmet hair. You feel eighteen until you get off.
outcomes.tip: A parking-lot tip-over, a cast and a bill. The bike now lives under a blanket.

ad2_reunion.text: The class reunion invite arrives. Everyone will have a glow-up, a business, or a story about their glow-up business.

outcomes.warm: Someone remembers the best thing about you. You'd forgotten it too.
outcomes.show: You spend the night nodding at someone's yacht photos. The food was fine.

ad2_dad_refuses_help.text: {{name}} climbs a ladder to clean the gutters. He is eighty-something in his heart. His knees disagree.

ad2_mother_moves_in.text: {{name}} can no longer manage alone. She says she will "just stay for a few weeks." She brings her own pillow.

outcomes.close: Mornings with tea and her old stories. It is harder than you'd planned and better.
outcomes.strain: Love is present. So is the argument about the thermostat.

ad2_mentor_junior.text: A new hire follows you around the office like a duckling. They ask good questions and fear you slightly.

ad2_new_hobby.text: The calendar has a rare empty evening. A friendly flyer in the supermarket offers woodworking, choir or oil painting.

ad2_fixer_house.text: A crumbling house is listed cheap. The agent uses the word "potential" nine times and "roof" zero times.

ad2_fixer_done.text: The fixer-upper is finally done. The last cupboard door closes with a click that sounds like victory.

outcomes.profit: The listing says "lovingly restored." It was. The buyer cried.
outcomes.flat: The market sneezes. You break even and keep the memories and splinters.

ad2_hoa_letter.text: The homeowners association writes that your mailbox is "not within color guidelines." The guidelines run four pages.

outcomes.won: You attend three meetings and a vote. Your mailbox stays defiantly teal.
outcomes.fined: You lose, pay the fine, and are elected to the committee as punishment.

ad2_scam_tech.text: A pop-up warns that your computer has "47 viruses." It also offers a phone number staffed by a very polite stranger.

outcomes.scammed: He fixes nothing and sells you a fix for the fix. The card gets cancelled.
outcomes.lucky: The line is dead, and your sense of dread was merely a warm-up.

ad2_friend_scam_invest.text: {{name}} confides in a thrilling opportunity: a coin invented last Tuesday. Everyone in the chat is "getting in early."

outcomes.gain: It goes up. Then, exactly one hour after you stop checking, down. You break even.
outcomes.loss: The coin vanishes into the clouds. {{name}} blames the weather.

ad2_checkup_numbers.text: The doctor reads your checkup numbers in the tone of a weather report. Cloudy, with a chance of salad.

ad2_windfall_refund.text: A forgotten envelope contains a class-action settlement check for $1,340 from a company you have never heard of.

ad2_lawsuit_slip.text: A delivery driver slips on your porch and says "see you in court" as they limp away. It was a damp leaf.

outcomes.won: The case is dismissed. Your lawyer's invoice feels like a second lawsuit.
outcomes.lost: The settlement is smaller than feared and larger than hoped.

ad2_viral_clip.text: Someone films you arguing with a vending machine. By morning, four million strangers have opinions about your technique.

ad2_viral_fallout.text: A company offers you a small fee to recreate your moment for an ad. The vending machine, they assure you, will not sue.

outcomes.win: They pay for your name and your face. You spend it on a vending machine for home.
outcomes.gone: They move on to a goose who fell off a boat. Your fame is over.

ad2_witness.text: You see a car clip a parked van and drive off. The owner appears, confused. You are the only one who saw.

ad2_child_driving.text: {{name}} gets a learner's permit. You are in the passenger seat, pressing a pedal that does not exist.

outcomes.good: Calm voices, empty parking lots. A bonding moment, plus one traffic cone.
outcomes.shouted: There is shouting. There is a curb. You both agree on a driving school.

ad2_child_college_cost.text: {{name}} got into a great college. The tuition letter is attached. You read it twice and then once more standing.

ad2_spouse_trip.text: {{name}} wants to book a "once-in-a-lifetime" trip: eleven days, four countries and a boat named Gerald.

ad2_sibling_stuff.text: Sorting out your parents' house brings out {{name}}. Everyone claims the same clock and nobody remembers the clock.

ad2_novel_start.text: You have wanted to write a novel for twenty years. Tonight you have a laptop, a lamp and a first sentence.

ad2_novel_result.text: The manuscript is finished. Four hundred pages that smell faintly of coffee and effort.

outcomes.deal: One publisher says yes. Your name is on a spine, tiny but real.
outcomes.reject: Fourteen rejections arrive. One includes advice. It is surprisingly good.

ad2_marathon_sign.text: A friend's daughter is raising money by running a marathon. You sign up to run the first six miles, out of guilt and a vague feeling of strength.

ad2_marathon_day.text: Race day. You are surrounded by people in matching shorts who all seem to know a secret.

outcomes.finish: You cross the line wobbling and sobbing. You would do it again. Not tomorrow.
outcomes.injury: At mile nine a knee files a complaint. You limp to a medal and a long recovery.

ad2_friend_laid_off.text: {{name}} got laid off today and invites you to "just dinner." You can hear the quiet behind the words.

ad2_layoff_rumor.text: Office rumor says layoffs come Friday. People whisper at the printer. The printer, for once, is not the source of stress.

outcomes.safe: Your boss says your role is safe. You choose to believe this.
outcomes.warned: You get a vague answer and an early warning. You start saving quickly.

ad2_empty_nest.text: The last kid has left and the house echoes. {{name}} looks at you across a table that seats six and says, "Hello, stranger."

ad2_knee_hike.text: You decide to join a hike "just for fun." By the second hill your knees begin to speak in complete sentences.

ad2_neighbor_cat.text: Your neighbor asks you to feed their cat for a week. The cat has strong views on the schedule.

outcomes.fat: The cat adores you. The vet later asks questions.
outcomes.gift: The neighbor returns with cookies and a lifelong friend in a fur coat.

ad2_ex_message.text: {{name}} sends you a message after fifteen years: "Saw something that reminded me of you. Hope you're well."

ad2_band_reunion.text: Your old garage band gets a surprise invitation to play a friend's fortieth anniversary party. Your fingers remember some of it.

outcomes.legend: Forty people sing along to a song you wrote at nineteen. You are briefly famous in a living room.
outcomes.flop: Two strings break and the drummer's back goes. Everyone claps politely.

ad2_grandkid_sitting.text: {{name}} asks you to watch the grandkids for a weekend. Their combined energy could power a small city.

ad2_retirement_community.text: A brochure promises a retirement community with a pool, a choir and "an active social calendar." The photo models are suspiciously tan.

outcomes.love: You make friends over bridge and bad coffee. Nobody pesters you about the thermostat.
outcomes.dull: The pool is cold and the choir sings one song. You miss your messy kitchen.

ad2_tablet_start.text: The grandchildren gave you a tablet. It is a shiny rectangle that wants a password you have never chosen.

ad2_tablet_pro.text: You now video-call people with fluent confidence. Last week you sent a perfect emoji. Your grandchild screenshots it for posterity.

ad2_bucket_list.text: You find an old list titled "Things to do someday." Someday has arrived. It is mostly items involving a hot air balloon.

ad2_bucket_done.text: You are in a basket beneath an enormous balloon. The pilot says "relax." Your stomach says other things.

outcomes.sublime: The valley looks like a quilt. You cry quietly and tell no one.
outcomes.scared: You grip the basket for forty minutes with your eyes shut. You can say you did it.

ad2_estate_will.text: A lawyer says it is time to decide who gets the house, the clock, and the good china. The china is not good.

ad2_hearing_aids.text: Everyone mumbles lately. Your family says it's your hearing. You say it's mumbling. A tiny device is recommended.

ad2_cataract.text: The world looks like it is covered by a milky film. The eye doctor smiles and says "cataracts," like it is a good thing.

outcomes.clear: Colors snap back. You notice the sky has been blue the whole time.
outcomes.meh: Mostly better, with one eye that now judges you.

ad2_scam_grandchild.text: A trembling voice calls: "Grandma/Grandpa, it's me, I'm in trouble, please don't tell Mom." You have several grandchildren.

outcomes.scam: The voice was not your grandchild. The money is not coming back.
outcomes.real: It is a real, slightly silly emergency. Your grandchild thanks you weeping.

ad2_scam_driveway.text: A friendly man at your door says your driveway "needs resurfacing today only." He is holding a bucket and a clipboard.

outcomes.fake: The driveway looks worse, and the man is gone with the bucket.
outcomes.ok: The job is poor but legitimate. You have a very smooth driveway.

ad2_late_love.text: At a community dance you meet someone who laughs at all your jokes, including the ones you did not mean as jokes.

outcomes.bloom: It begins with soup and ends with a second date. You haven't felt this since 1974.
outcomes.friends: You decide to stay good friends, with dancing. Not bad at all.

ad2_wisdom_young.text: A nervous teenager at the bus stop asks if you have any advice. You have nine hundred pieces and choose one.

ad2_old_photos.text: You find a shoebox of photos. Most faces you know. A few you only recognise by their hats.

ad2_ladder_cleanup.text: The gutters are full of leaves. A tall ladder leans against the house like an invitation.

outcomes.done: You clean the gutters and feel eighteen. Your knees disagree quietly.
outcomes.fall: The ladder shifts. A cast and three weeks of regret follow.
outcomes.gone: The ladder slips and so do you. A very quick end to a very tidy gutter.

ad2_snow_shovel.text: A foot of snow blocks your driveway. You own a shovel and an unreasonable amount of pride.

outcomes.fine: You finish, breathless and smug, and drink cocoa like a champion.
outcomes.strain: Your chest tightens. A short hospital stay becomes a long lesson.
outcomes.gone: Halfway through the driveway, your heart makes its own decision.

ad2_ice_walk.text: The morning sidewalk looks wet but is actually ice. Your favourite bakery is just across the street.

outcomes.bread: You arrive, slightly triumphant, and buy twice as many rolls.
outcomes.slip: You slip with great dignity and a very loud noise. A bruise blooms.
outcomes.gone: The ice is cruel and your head meets the curb. A fast, strange ending.

ad2_anniversary_fifty.text: {{name}} and you reach an anniversary so long that people have started to clap before you tell them the number.

ad2_old_friend_call.text: {{name}} calls just to say nothing important for an hour. It's the best phone call this month.

ad2_drivers_license.text: Your license renewal comes with an eye test and a gentle suggestion from your family: "maybe just for the daytime."

outcomes.fine: You pass and drive home slowly, proud and obeying every sign.
outcomes.fender: A fender bender in the parking lot. It is somehow the other car's fault, mostly.

ad2_memoir_stories.text: Your grandchildren ask how life was "before phones." You tell them. Midway they stop looking at the phone.

ad2_sibling_old.text: {{name}} phones at breakfast to compare aches. You keep a running score. You are winning, which is a loss.

ad2_child_gift_tech.text: {{name}} installs a smart speaker in your kitchen. It now answers questions nobody asked, and politely, too.
